qa_pairs.instruction: What is the DirXML-WorkOrder object and why is it used in the Work Order driver?
qa_pairs.output: The DirXML-WorkOrder object, sometimes called the WorkOrder object, tells the Work Order driver what tasks to perform. It can delay execution until a specific date and time or until another work order completes, and it can repeat work orders at a defined interval.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which attributes are defined for the DirXML-WorkOrder object in the Work Order driver, and what are their descriptions and data types?
qa_pairs.output:
The DirXML-WorkOrder object defines the following attributes:
| Attribute | Description | Type |
|---|---|---|
| Description | Description of the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Case ignore string |
| Common Name | The naming attribute for eDirectory. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoContact Name | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoContent | Passed through to the WorkToDo object; used by policies to process the work order. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-DueDate | The date and time the work order is to be processed. | Time |
| DirXML-nwoDoItNowFlag | If True, the Subscriber channel sends the work order to the Publisher channel to be processed immediately. | Boolean |
| DirXML-nwoSendToPublisher | If True, the Subscriber channel sends the work order to the Publisher channel to be written to the WorkOrder container. | Boolean |
| DirXML-woType | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | User defined |
| DirXML-nwoCreationDate | Information about the work order. | Time |
| DirXML-nwoDependentWorkOrder | DN of the dependent work order; the work order is not processed until this dependent order has a status of Configured. | Distinguished Name |
| DirXML-nwoRepeatInterval | Amount of time, in minutes, before the work order is repeated; added to the due date after processing. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoRepeatCount | Number of times to repeat the work order; used with DirXML-nwoRepeatInterval. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoStatus | Status of the work order (Pending, Configured, Error, On Hold). | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoWorkOrderNumber | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoDeleteOnError | If True, the work order is deleted if the status is Error and the DeleteDueDate has expired. | Boolean |
| DirXML-nwoProcessLog | Contains information relating to the processing of the work order. | Case ignore string |
| DirXML-nwoDeleteDueDate | Shows the date and time the work order will be deleted when status is Pending or Configured. | Time |
| DirXML-CreatorName | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Distinguished Name |
| DirXML-Other1 | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Case ignore string |
| DriXML-Other2 | Information about the work order. Passed through to the WorkToDo object. | Case ignore string |

qa_pairs.instruction: Which attribute controls immediate processing of a work order in the Work Order driver, and what value must it have?
qa_pairs.output: The attribute DirXML-nwoDoItNowFlag controls immediate processing. It must be set to True (Boolean) for the Subscriber channel to send the work order to the Publisher channel for immediate processing.

qa_pairs.instruction: How does the Work Order driver handle dependent work orders, and which attribute specifies the dependency?
qa_pairs.output: The Work Order driver does not process a work order until its dependent work order has a status of Configured. The dependency is specified with the DirXML-nwoDependentWorkOrder attribute, which holds the Distinguished Name of the dependent work order. If this attribute is missing or empty, the dependency is ignored.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which attributes are required to configure a repeating work order in the Work Order driver, and what do they represent?
qa_pairs.output:
To configure a repeating work order, you need:
* DirXML-nwoRepeatInterval – the amount of time, in minutes, before the work order is repeated. It is a Case ignore string and its value is added to the due date after each processing.
* DirXML-nwoRepeatCount – the number of times the work order should repeat. It is a Case ignore string and must be used together with DirXML-nwoRepeatInterval.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you create a work order that is processed immediately using the Work Order driver?
qa_pairs.output:
To create an immediately processed work order in the Work Order driver:
1. Create a DirXML-WorkOrder object.
2. Set the DirXML-nwoDoItNowFlag attribute to True (Boolean).
3. Optionally set DirXML-nwoSendToPublisher to True if you also want the work order written to the WorkOrder container.
4. Populate any required informational attributes (e.g., Description, DirXML-nwoContent, DirXML-woType).
5. Save the object; the Subscriber channel will send it to the Publisher channel for immediate processing.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you configure a work order to be automatically deleted when an error occurs in the Work Order driver?
qa_pairs.output:
To have a work order automatically deleted after an error in the Work Order driver:
1. Create or edit the DirXML-WorkOrder object.
2. Set the DirXML-nwoDeleteOnError attribute to True (Boolean).
3. Ensure the DirXML-nwoDeleteDueDate attribute contains the date and time after which the work order may be deleted.
4. Save the object; if the work order status becomes Error and the DeleteDueDate has passed, the driver will delete the work order.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the key features and configurable attributes of the DirXML-WorkOrder object used by the Work Order driver.
qa_pairs.output:
The DirXML-WorkOrder object lets the Work Order driver schedule, delay, repeat, and manage work orders. Key features include:
* Scheduling with DirXML-DueDate.
* Immediate execution via DirXML-nwoDoItNowFlag.
* Dependency handling using DirXML-nwoDependentWorkOrder.
* Repeating work orders using DirXML-nwoRepeatInterval and DirXML-nwoRepeatCount.
* Status tracking with DirXML-nwoStatus (Pending, Configured, Error, On Hold).
* Automatic deletion on error with DirXML-nwoDeleteOnError and DirXML-nwoDeleteDueDate.
* Various informational attributes (Description, DirXML-nwoContent, DirXML-woType, etc.) that are passed through to the WorkToDo object unchanged.
